field_meaning.hi: अपराध की निंदा पर समाज में सुधार लाना।

review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi definition 'अपराध की निंदा पर समाज में सुधार लाना' (bringing reform in society through condemnation of crime) is incorrect. Reintegrative shaming is a criminological concept (associated with John Braithwaite) that involves condemning the *act* while reaffirming the offender's membership in the community to encourage reintegration, not general societal reform through condemnation.
